import subprocess

# Spec sequence: f(0)=1, f(1)=1, f(n)=f(n-1)+f(n-2)  => 1,1,2,3,5,8,13,...
ref = [1, 1]
for _ in range(2, 251):
    ref.append(ref[-1] + ref[-2])

ns = list(range(0, 91)) + [150, 200, 250]
fails = []
for n in ns:
    r = subprocess.run(['/app/polyglot/main', str(n)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    c = subprocess.run(['/app/polyglot/cmain', str(n)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0 or c.returncode != 0:
        fails.append((n, 'rc', r.returncode, c.returncode, r.stderr[:120], c.stderr[:120]))
        continue
    got_r, got_c, exp = r.stdout.strip(), c.stdout.strip(), str(ref[n])
    if got_r != exp or got_c != exp:
        fails.append((n, 'rust=' + got_r, 'cxx=' + got_c, 'exp=' + exp))

print('spot-check f(0..6):', [subprocess.run(['/app/polyglot/main', str(i)], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() for i in range(7)], 'expected:', ['1', '1', '2', '3', '5', '8', '13'])
print('indices tested:', len(ns), '(0..90, 150, 200, 250)')
print('rust vs c++ vs spec failures:', fails if fails else 'NONE')
print('f(250) digit count:', len(str(ref[250])))
EOF
